title: Add a new competitor and their first entry
for: Show office staff and secretaries taking entries at the office or over the phone

steps.title: Check the current show
steps.instruction: Sign in and start on the Dashboard. Check the Current show at the bottom of the left-hand menu is the show you're taking entries for.

steps.title: Open Competitors
steps.instruction: Click Competitors in the left-hand menu.

steps.title: Search before you add
steps.instruction: Competitors are shared across all your shows. Type the person's name into Search competitors... first, so you don't create a duplicate. If they're already listed, skip ahead to their profile.

steps.title: Add New Competitor
steps.instruction: No match? Click Add New Competitor at the top right.

steps.title: Enter their name
steps.instruction: Enter the competitor's First Name and Last Name (both required, at least two characters).

steps.title: Add contact details
steps.instruction: Email and Phone are optional. With an email address, TallyUp sends the competitor an entry confirmation and you can email them a payment link later.

steps.title: Create Competitor
steps.instruction: Click Create Competitor. A Competitor created message appears and you're returned to the competitor list.

steps.title: Open their profile
steps.instruction: Search for the competitor again and click View on their row to open their profile.

steps.title: Add Entry
steps.instruction: The profile shows their details and entries for this show (none yet). Under Quick Actions, click Add Entry.

steps.title: Competitor already selected
steps.instruction: The Add New Entry form opens with the competitor already selected.

steps.title: Choose a class
steps.instruction: Click Select a class... and search by class name, code or section — for example banana — then click the class (shown as code and name, e.g. CK03 - Banana bread).

steps.title: Entry number and fee
steps.instruction: For automatically numbered classes the form notes Entry numbers will be assigned automatically when you submit. The Entry Summary on the right adds up the fees. (Classes with hand-entered numbers, such as poultry cage numbers, show an Entry Number (Optional) box instead.)

steps.title: Optional description
steps.instruction: Optionally add an Entry Description. To enter the same competitor in more classes, click Add Another Entry and repeat for each class.

steps.title: Submit Entry
steps.instruction: Check the details and click Submit Entry.

steps.title: Entry submitted
steps.instruction: The entry is saved with its entry number and shows Payment Pending. Choose Send Link to email a secure payment link, or Record Payment for cash or EFTPOS. Create Another Entry starts a fresh form.

title: Find unpaid entries
for: Show office staff following up entry fees

steps.title: Open Entries
steps.instruction: Click Entries in the left-hand menu.

steps.title: Choose Unpaid
steps.instruction: Open Payment Status and choose {{filter.status}}.

steps.title: Apply Filters
steps.instruction: Click Apply Filters. The list shows only unpaid entries.

title: Record a payment
for: Show office staff taking entry fees at the office

steps.title: Open Payments
steps.instruction: Click Payments in the left-hand menu.

steps.title: New Payment
steps.instruction: Click New Payment.

steps.title: Choose the competitor
steps.instruction: Click Select competitor... and choose the person who paid.

steps.title: Enter the amount
steps.instruction: Enter the Amount ($). Payment Type is already Entry Fee and Payment Method is Cash.

steps.title: Enter the receipt number
steps.instruction: Enter the Receipt Number, if you gave one.

steps.title: Save Payment
steps.instruction: Click Save Payment. The payment shows in the Payments list.

title: Update a competitor's phone number
for: Show office staff keeping competitor details current

steps.title: Search for the competitor
steps.instruction: On Competitors, type the person's name in Search.

steps.title: Open their profile
steps.instruction: Click View on the competitor's row.

steps.title: Edit Profile
steps.instruction: Click Edit Profile.

steps.title: Change the phone number
steps.instruction: Replace the number in Phone.

steps.title: Save Changes
steps.instruction: Click Save Changes. The profile shows the new number.
